identity.name: Courtside & Crown
identity.one_line_description: Courtside & Crown is a heritage tennis academy website that showcases elite coaching programmes, club history, match fixtures, and news for players and families who value tradition, excellence, and community.

sections.intent: Set the tone for the Club page as a proud, authoritative account of who we are and what we stand for.
sections.headline: A Club Built on Courts and Character
sections.subheadline: Since 1923, Courtside & Crown has shaped players and people in equal measure.
sections.body: What began as a small grass-court club in the heart of the county has grown into one of the region's most respected tennis academies. Our walls carry the portraits of champions; our courts carry the footsteps of thousands of members whose lives were changed by the game.

asset_ideas.subject: A vintage-style timeline banner showing key milestones of the club from 1923 to present, with small iconographic markers for each decade.
asset_ideas.purpose: Visual anchor for the club history narrative that communicates longevity and prestige in a single glance.

sections.intent: Chronicle the academy's most significant milestones to deepen emotional investment and reinforce the heritage brand story.
sections.headline: One Hundred Years, One Unbroken Tradition

items.title: 1923 — Founded
items.description: Courtside & Crown opens with four grass courts and thirty founding members on the Harrowfield estate.

items.title: 1951 — First County Title
items.description: Our men's first team claims the county championship for the first time, cementing our competitive reputation.

items.title: 1974 — Clubhouse Expansion
items.description: The iconic red-brick clubhouse is extended, adding a viewing terrace, lounge, and junior changing facilities.

items.title: 1989 — Junior Academy Launched
items.description: A dedicated junior coaching pathway is introduced, producing three national-ranked juniors within a decade.

items.title: 2003 — Indoor Courts Added
items.description: Two all-weather indoor courts ensure year-round play and open the academy to a wider community.

items.title: 2023 — Centenary Season
items.description: Courtside & Crown celebrates 100 years with a centenary tournament, alumni weekend, and the launch of our scholarship programme.

sections.intent: Feature a longer, in-depth editorial piece that deepens the brand story and creates a sense of a living, breathing club culture.
sections.headline: One Hundred Years of Courtside & Crown: A Century Remembered
sections.subheadline: From four grass courts on a country estate to a thriving academy of three thousand members — the story of how a club became a community.
sections.body: When Colonel Edmund Harrowfield laid out the first four courts on his estate in the summer of 1923, he could not have imagined that a century later, thousands of players would call this place their sporting home. What began as a gentlemen's pastime became, over the decades, a school of champions, a refuge for beginners, and a gathering place for families across the county. The centenary season is not a celebration of the past alone — it is a declaration of intent. The next hundred years start now.

sections.intent: Answer the most common questions from prospective members and coaching enquirers to reduce barriers and pre-qualify visitors before they get in touch.
sections.headline: Before You Write, We May Already Have Your Answer

items.title: Do I need to be an experienced player to join?
items.description: Not at all. We welcome complete beginners of all ages. Our adult beginner programme and junior starter sessions are designed for players with no prior experience.

items.title: Can I try the club before committing to membership?
items.description: Yes. We offer a complimentary trial session for all prospective members. Contact the office to arrange a suitable time.

items.title: How do I enter a squad or competitive team?
items.description: Competitive squad places are allocated following a brief assessment session with our head coach. Contact the coaching team to arrange a trial.

items.title: Is the club suitable for children with disabilities?
items.description: Courtside & Crown is committed to inclusive tennis. We offer adapted tennis sessions and our facilities are accessible. Please contact us to discuss your child's specific needs.

items.title: Can I hire a court without being a member?
items.description: Non-member court hire is available at weekday off-peak times, subject to availability. Contact the office for rates and booking.
